sealing.pre_cleanup_manifest: Seal all evidence that exists before cleanup.
sealing.post_cleanup_attachment: Attach cleanup.json after cleanup and re-anchor; the pre-cleanup evidence remains immutable.

rules: Cleanup means no disposable process or temporary worktree remains.
Cleanup never means deleting success, failure or unknown evidence.
A sealed evidence set is immutable; cleanup adds a separately anchored attachment.
Independent review must verify file contents and reference reachability, not only hashes.
WP5 completion forbids disposable residue, not retained report evidence.
